guitar.evidence: James Taylor is well known for his James Olson-built acoustic guitars (custom-made for him) and earlier Martin guitars; well documented in interviews.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with high confidence given his fame as a fingerstyle acoustic player.

tone.target: warm fingerpicked acoustic steel-string with dry room
tone.profile: warm fingerpicked acoustic steel-string with dry room
tone.summary: The chain uses a clean preamp (US Deluxe) paired with an acoustic-friendly cabinet (US 2x12). Compression smooths the attack, while EQ shapes the low-mids to mimic warm steel strings. A subtle Room reverb adds depth without sounding wet.
